title: Waiting 10 Years to Invest Costs You $418,000
hook: Starting to invest at 35 instead of 25 doesn't cost you ten years — it costs you $418,000.
angle: Most people know 'start early' matters, but nobody shows them the actual dollar gap. Seeing $418K on screen is viscerally motivating in a way vague advice never is.
audience: Anyone in their 20s–40s who has been putting off investing, or parents who want to motivate their kids
